basic_info.description: Residence 63A redefines luxury living with impeccable design and breathtaking views. This newly priced residence features 3 bedrooms, 3.5 baths, and 1,882 sq. ft. of meticulously curated space. Soaring bay and skyline vistas frame the open living and dining area, while French oak floors lead to a gourmet kitchen outfitted with Miele and Sub-Zero appliances. The primary bath, clad in Arabescato Corchia marble, offers a serene retreat, and the bedroom's custom sliding wall reveals a hidden Sura 55 televisionseamlessly blending elegance and innovation. Designed by ODADA, this home exudes sophistication, with bespoke touches like a Polyform-designed walk-in closet and Lutron solar shades throughout. The option for a turnkey furnished residence ensures effortless luxury. Beyond the allure of privacy & unrivaled views, 181 Fremont sets a new standard for luxury living with 5-star services, a world-class art program, & an exclusive Residents' Club. Enjoy the 360-degree open-air terrace, fireside gathering area, inviting lounges, state-of-the-art fitness center with a yoga studio. Notably, 181 Fremont offers direct access to Salesforce Park, a 5.4-acre oasis at your doorstep. Additional parking available.
